storage.notes: No memory card slot; iSCSI recording supported.

features: Variable pan/tilt speed 0.1-120 deg/s; preset speed pan 360 deg/s, tilt 100 deg/s
99 presets, 1 preset tour, 2 recorded tours, 2 auto-pan modes
Tri-streaming: two H.264 streams plus one JPEG stream
Embedded Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA) and MOTION+
Sensitivity 0.83 lx at 30 IRE (tinted bubble, SensUP off); 0.043 lx with SensUP on
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AutoDomeEasyII_IP_Data_sheet_enUS_2461381387.pdf). Indoor models. SKU code: VEZ-2[1=PAL|2=NTSC]1-I[W=white|C=charcoal][C=clear|T=tinted bubble]EIVA (IVA = IP with IVA). min_lux_color is the datasheet's 30 IRE figure measured with the tinted bubble (clear bubble approx. 0.6 F-stop better). Max frame rate 30 ips NTSC / 25 ips PAL. Datasheet dated Oct 2013.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
